Model Text Summary:
An expository narrative surveying India's astonishing natural, biological, and geological marvels. It highlights the living root bridges of Meghalaya (engineered by Khasi tribes from Ficus elastica roots), the unique floating National Park of Keibul Lamjao in Manipur (phumdis), bioluminescent beaches of Goa/Karnataka, the magnetic gravity-defying hill of Ladakh, and Lonar Meteorite Crater Lake in Maharashtra. The chapter blends scientific explanation with ecological preservation principles.
